claims.claim: BWXT was selected on August 26 for the U.S. Army Janus program and on September 3 for NNSA lithium-processing-facility conceptual design, extending its nuclear capability set beyond its established naval base.

risks.risk: Program selections and conceptual-design awards do not establish full production economics or timing.

unknowns.unknown: Contract value and downstream production scope for the NNSA design award are not disclosed in the retrieved release.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 revenue rose 18% year over year to $901.6M; BWXT raised 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance to $662M-$672M and free-cash-flow guidance to $345M-$360M, while Commercial Operations revenue rose 72%.

risks.risk: Government Operations operating income declined 3% year over year in Q2 and execution remains exposed to contract mix and program timing.

unknowns.unknown: Valuation attractiveness is not established by this operating evidence.
